test_title: PYST 103: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 11 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six candidates Anand, Balu, Charan, Dinesh, Emran and Farhad were seated on a circular table for group discussion at equal distance, facing the centre of the circle. Dinesh is the immediate neighbour of Emran and Balu while Charan is the immediate neighbour of Anand and Farhad. If Farhad is to the immediate right of Balu, then who is on the immediate right of Dinesh?
solution: Given: Six candidates Anand, Balu, Charan, Dinesh, Emran and Farhad. Dinesh is the immediate neighbour of Emran and Balu while If 1) Farhad is to the immediate right of Balu. 2) Dinesh is the immediate neighbour of Emran and Balu.
